description: List this workspace's activities (tasks, calls, meetings, emails, notes), filtered by type/assignee/overdue/completion/linked-entity and paginated. Returns summary rows (id, type, title, priority, dueDate, completed, assignee, linked lead/contact/company/deal, isOverdue) plus pagination { page, perPage, total }. Use get_activity to fetch one activity's full detail by id.

assignedTo.description: Filter to activities assigned to this workspace member's user id.

companyId.description: Filter to activities linked to this company id (from search_companies).

completed.description: Filter by completion: "true" only completed, "false" only open. Omit for both.

contactId.description: Filter to activities linked to this contact id (from search_contacts).

dealId.description: Filter to activities linked to this deal id (from search_deals).

leadId.description: Filter to activities linked to this lead id (from search_leads).

overdue.description: Set "true" to return only overdue activities (past due date, not completed).

page.description: 1-based page number of results to return. Default 1.

perPage.description: Number of activities per page (1-100). Default 20.

q.description: Free-text search over the activity title. Omit for no text filter.

type.description: Filter by activity type. Omit for any. Allowed: task, call, meeting, email, note.

name: list_activities
title: List activities
